inputs.question: Where is my order ORD-1182? I ordered 6 days ago.

outputs.answer: Sorry for the wait! Orders arrive in 3-5 business days, so yours is a little late. I have raised a delivery check on ORD-1182 and you will get an update by email within 24 hours.

inputs.question: How do I return shoes that don't fit?

outputs.answer: Go to My Orders, pick the shoes and choose Return within 7 days of delivery. A courier collects them and the refund reaches you 5-7 days after pickup.

inputs.question: My refund hasn't come. Call me on 98200 12345 or mail priya.n@example.com

outputs.answer: I'm sorry about the delay, Priya. Refunds reach your account 5-7 days after pickup. I have flagged yours to the payments team, who will contact you on 98200 12345 today.

inputs.question: Is the phone under warranty if the screen cracks?

outputs.answer: Yes, the warranty covers everything, including cracked screens.
Yes, we deliver on Sundays in most cities. The delivery date shown at checkout already includes Sunday slots.

inputs.question: Payment failed but money was deducted
How do I apply a promo code?

outputs.answer: Type the code in the Apply coupon box on the payment page and press Apply. The discount shows before you pay.
Yes - we accept UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking and cash on delivery.

inputs.question: Change my delivery address after ordering?

outputs.answer: You can change the address in My Orders until the order is shipped. After that, contact us and we will try to redirect it with the courier.

inputs.question: I want to cancel my order
How do I delete my account?

outputs.answer: Go to Account > Settings > Delete account. Any open orders must be delivered or cancelled first, and deletion is permanent.

inputs.question: The parcel says delivered but I didn't get it

outputs.answer: Sorry about that! Please check with neighbours and building security first. If it's still missing, report it in My Orders within 48 hours and we will open an investigation with the courier.
Yes - no-cost EMI for 3 and 6 months is available on most credit cards for orders above Rs. 3,000. Choose EMI on the payment page.

inputs.question: Exchange a shirt for a bigger size

outputs.answer: Sure - in My Orders choose Exchange within 7 days of delivery, pick the new size, and we collect the old shirt when we deliver the new one.

inputs.question: How long does a refund take?

outputs.answer: Refunds reach your original payment method 5-7 business days after we receive the item.
